question: Should Skill Workshop add a core `review` action and bind pending lifecycle approvals to the reviewed proposal version while preserving optional version guards for direct calls?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well proven, but it permanently expands the model-facing tool and CLI contract and deliberately changes how stale pending approvals behave.

options.title: Approve bounded core contract
options.body: Accept the review action, portable pagination, and snapshot-bound pending approvals while retaining compatibility for direct proposal-ID calls.

options.title: Narrow the approval change
options.body: Accept read-only previews but require the contributor to separate or reduce automatic proposal-version binding before merge.

options.title: Decline core expansion
options.body: Keep the existing inspect-and-summary workflow and close the paired feature direction rather than adding another core action.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the review action, portable pagination, and snapshot-bound pending approvals while retaining compatibility for direct proposal-ID calls.

likelyOwner.reason: History most directly ties this person to the core Skill Workshop tool and lifecycle approval contract being expanded.
